entries.en: Mr Byrd offered to drive us to the station.
entries.zh: 伯德先生提出开车送我们去车站。

entries.en: Ms Grimm keeps a spare key in her desk drawer.
entries.zh: 格林姆女士在书桌抽屉里放着一把备用钥匙。

entries.en: She sent a job application to Toshiba last week.
entries.zh: 她上周向东芝投递了一份求职申请。

entries.en: Dr Yang explained the test results in plain language.
entries.zh: 杨医生用浅显的语言解释了检查结果。

entries.en: Ms Addis asked the class to compare the two photographs.
entries.zh: 艾缔思老师让全班比较这两张照片。

entries.en: They stopped for lunch in Augusta before continuing their journey.
entries.zh: 他们在奥古斯塔停下来吃午饭，然后继续赶路。

entries.meaningZh: 海中女神（《奥德赛》中的人物）
entries.en: Our reading group discussed Calypso's role in the Odyssey.
entries.zh: 我们读书小组讨论了这位海中女神在《奥德赛》中的角色。

entries.en: Cosmo brought a notebook so he could sketch on the train.
entries.zh: 科兹摩带了一个本子，好在火车上画速写。

entries.en: The Yamaha piano had been carefully tuned before the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会前，那架雅马哈钢琴已经仔细调好了音。

entries.en: Mrs Hurley left a note for the neighbours before going away.
entries.zh: 赫尔利太太出门前给邻居们留了一张便条。

entries.en: The exhibition included photographs taken in Sinai.
entries.zh: 展览中有在西奈拍摄的照片。

entries.en: Mr Hobbes returned the borrowed ladder on Sunday.
entries.zh: 霍布斯先生星期日归还了借来的梯子。

entries.meaningZh: 纠缠者；紧黏着他人不放的人（比喻）
entries.en: At the party, he was a limpet, following his host from room to room.
entries.zh: 聚会上，他像个黏人不放的纠缠者，跟着主人从一个房间走到另一个房间。

entries.en: Ms Getty checked the room numbers before handing out the keys.
entries.zh: 盖提女士先核对了房间号，然后才分发钥匙。

entries.meaningZh: 法蒂玛（穆罕默德的女儿）
entries.en: The class read a short biography of Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad.
entries.zh: 全班读了一篇关于穆罕默德之女法蒂玛的短篇传记。

entries.meaningZh: 盖世太保；纳粹秘密警察
entries.en: The museum explains how the Gestapo used fear to silence opposition.
entries.zh: 博物馆介绍了盖世太保如何利用恐惧压制反对声音。

entries.en: Their travel notes included a brief stop in Maman.
entries.zh: 他们的旅行笔记记下了在马曼的短暂停留。

entries.meaningZh: 宝兰公司；宝蓝（美国软件公司）
entries.en: The developer compared Borland's tools before buying a licence.
entries.zh: 那位开发人员比较了宝兰公司的工具，然后才购买许可证。

entries.en: Ms Nguyen volunteered to show the new students around campus.
entries.zh: 阮女士自愿带新同学参观校园。
